name: Triumph Bonneville T140
engine: 744 cc air-cooled OHV parallel twin, two Amal carbs, oil in frame
intro: The last Meriden Bonneville. Spares are easy. Bikes that sat for decades need a real rebuild.

add.title: Clean the oil tank in the frame
add.instructions: Drain the frame oil tank and flush out sludge. Check the strainer. If the frame was blasted, make sure no grit is left inside.
add.reason: Sludge or blast grit in the frame tank goes straight into the engine.

H: Bikes that stood for decades usually have hard seals and corroded internals. Plan on a full engine rebuild.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Long storage
known.what: Hard oil seals and corroded engine and gearbox internals are common on bikes that sat for years.
